info.title: tiko API
info.description: Read and arrange your boards and search your tasks. Every call needs an API key from Settings → API keys in the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

Element.title: Element
Element.description: One element; fields that do not belong to its kind are left out of the answer.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Every error of v1; clients must ignore codes they do not know.

FrameRef.title: FrameRef
FrameRef.description: An existing frame by `id`, or a new one below the board by `title`.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One step: an `op` and the fields that op takes.

API key.description:
Send an API key in the `Authorization` header of every call:

```
Authorization: Bearer tiko_…
```

Make one in Settings → API keys, for all your boards or only the ones you pick. See [API keys](/api-keys/) for what a key may do and how long it lives.
